items.title: Pay invoice for electrical work
items.quote: Zahlbar innerhalb von 14 Tagen nach Rechnungsdatum ohne Abzug.
items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) is 20.03.2026. The period runs 'nach Rechnungsdatum' (after the invoice date), so per §187(1) BGB the day of the event (20.03.) is not counted and the period starts on 21.03.2026. Counting 14 days from 21.03.2026 (day 1) gives day 14 = 03.04.2026 (§188(1) BGB). 03.04.2026 is Karfreitag (Good Friday), a public holiday in NRW. The following days 04.04. (Sat) and 05.04. (Sun, Easter Sunday) and 06.04. (Ostermontag/Easter Monday, also a NRW public holiday) are likewise non-business days. Per §193 BGB, when the last day of a period falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, the period ends on the next business day, which is Tuesday 07.04.2026.
